Name: Scaleer fork
Author: YYPch
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]
I have uploaded this as a separate mod due to the extensive internal changes made while modifying [b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/43647]Scaleer[/url][/b].[/color]


[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[color=#d4d4d8]
The usage is identical to [b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/43647]Scaleer[/url][/b]. [/color]


[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]

Modified the logic to resolve overlapping functions with [b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1348]SpaceCore[/url][/b].
Improved the loading structure to reduce delays during game loading and saving.

+1.0.1
Fixed an issue where DynamicShader shadows were not rendering properly.
Due to technical limitations, Willy's fishing motion has been completely hidden.




thanks to Macroush for allowing me to share this modified version.
